name: Lentil walnut salad with cottage cheese

steps.text: Dress warm-cooled lentils with half the vinaigrette.
steps.cue: The lentils are barely warm. Warm lentils absorb the dressing best.

steps.text: Toss in arugula and cucumber just before serving.
Top with spoonfuls of cottage cheese and toasted walnuts.
steps.cue: The walnuts are fragrant and a shade darker.
steps.tip: Toast them in a dry pan for 2 minutes and watch them. They burn fast.
